verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say social login is enabled from the admin console by selecting the social network, with no code or application changes. Any external OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 identity provider can likewise be brokered through admin-console configuration. Independent users confirm it: Google SSO was "a few settings away" and one team integrated many external IdPs across several software stacks. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of the built-in social providers to prove breadth, and in-depth per-provider setup documentation in the pack.
